items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: INTERVIEWER: There's one picture of the Superia band taken with Keele... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, well he played with most of the bands.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, Freddie Capard was not the Superia, and Bunk Johnson. There's Bunk Johnson. Who was playing clarinet with them?
There's one picture of the Superia band taken with Keele, not Keele, but Big Eye even in that. Big Eye played.
Yes, well he played with most of the bands.
